outcomes: A workspace that binds @putnami/cloud to the tasks and proposals contracts publishes, reviews, readies and auto-merges its pull requests and reads and closes its issues through Putnami Source and the Putnami GitHub App, under the signed-in Putnami session, with no GitHub token on the machine
nonGoals: Falling back from @putnami/github-collaboration to Putnami Source: the core binds one provider per contract, and a workspace chooses this one in options.collaboration
Finding, creating, updating or linking issues, and merging a pull request at once: Putnami Source does not serve them, so they answer unsupported
Installing the Putnami GitHub App or linking the workspace: putnami cloud source connect and putnami cloud setup do both

text: The @putnami/cloud manifest declares version 1 of the tasks and proposals contracts, run by its own runtime with the provider argument, and every operation each version requires.
The proposals contract also declares comments and automerge; the tasks contract also declares assign.
upsert, transition and assign declare checked preconditions: Source compares the expected revision with what it read before it writes.

proposals.find, upsert, status, comments, review and automerge, and tasks.get, transition and assign, each send one request to the matching route of Putnami Source under /v1/workspaces/{workspace}/source/, for the workspace putnami cloud setup linked.
Each answers the collaboration document Source answers.

Source's refusals keep their outcome: a missing item is not_found, a stale revision or a moved head is a conflict with the current revision when Source names it, a refused credential or permission is denied, and an invalid request is invalid.
A binding whose settings carry any member is invalid, and a workspace with no Cloud link answers unavailable and names putnami cloud setup.

requirements.text: tasks.find, create, update and link, and proposals.merge, answer unsupported with reason operation.unsupported and send no request: Source serves none of them.

text: Every call presents the workspace-scoped bearer of the session putnami cloud login stored, refreshed when it expired.
PUTNAMI_CLOUD_TOKEN is used only when no stored session can give one, and a valid session wins over it.
Without either, the operation sends nothing and answers denied, naming putnami cloud login.
A write is sent once, with the caller's idempotency key when the operation takes one.

When its outcome is unknown, because the connection broke after the request left, the deadline passed or Source answered a server error, the operation answers unresolved, names the read that settles it (proposals.find or proposals.status for a proposal write, tasks.get for a task write), and never sends it again.
A read that fails the same way answers unavailable and is retryable.

requirements.text: No answer, message or result the provider writes contains the bearer it presented or the value of PUTNAMI_CLOUD_TOKEN: each is replaced before the answer leaves the process.
